note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real server, network or load balancer. Every wait the Load balancing module shows comes from these and from the traffic file.

words.service: a fine server takes 20 to 60 ms of work per request, 40 ms on average, and works on one request per slot at a time
words.slow: a slow server takes 5 times as long over everything, its health check included
words.gray: a slow-but-answering server takes 5 times as long over real requests, but answers the cheap health check at once
words.trouble: a server's trouble starts 1 second in, as the sale begins
words.timeout: a customer gives up on a request after 1 second with no answer
words.checks: the balancer checks every server every 200 ms; no answer within 100 ms is a miss
